_README: THE ONE PLACE A VIDEO GETS ADDED. website/videos.html reads this file at
runtime and renders it; adding a video means appending one object to the
right series' "videos" array here, and editing nothing else, anywhere.
Fields on a video:
title    the video's own title, as published. Shown verbatim.
blurb    one or two sentences of public framing, in the site's voice.
Written fresh — never pasted from the script repo's production
notes, which read as internal craft documentation.
url      the direct YouTube watch URL, or null.
null renders a non-clickable card showing the stage instead.
NO PLAYLIST URLS — no comprehensive playlist exists. Link each
video directly, and never guess a URL.
state    'published' | 'written' | 'drafting'. Ignored when url holds a
value: a card with a URL always reads as published.
Fields on a series:
status   plain words for what the shelf holds right now. A series with
nothing published must read as intentional, not broken — this
line does that work, so keep it honest and keep it specific.
coming   optional. The foreshadow line: hint at the shape, withhold the
detail. No dates, no prices, no scope, no 'launching soon'.
Source of the series structure: ../youtube-script-drafts-daat-data (private;
docs/fleet/PROJECTS.md). Nothing here reads that repo — this file holds a hand-
written copy of what the public needs to know, and nothing more.

series.title: Esoteric to Exoteric
series.blurb: Take one piece of esoteric machinery — a philosophical claim, a buried mechanism, an assumption running backwards — and hand it over in a form a person can carry out of the room and use.
series.shape: Three to twelve minutes, depending on how far down the thing goes.
series.status: Three scripts finished. None cut yet.
series.coming: The fourth one sits half-written, and it goes after a word everybody uses and nobody defines.

videos.title: Why Religion Is Dying: Semantic Suicide Bombers
videos.blurb: A faith does not die when people stop believing it. It dies when the words stop pointing at anything, and five paradoxes walk in through the gap.

videos.title: Schizophrenia Doesn't Exist. English Does.
videos.blurb: What a diagnosis names, and what the grammar underneath it already decided before any doctor spoke.

videos.title: Your Politics Built the Cage. Both of You.
videos.blurb: Two sides, one architecture. Neither wing of a cage reads as an exit.

series.title: You Are Not X
series.blurb: Each one takes a label a viewer wears and asks what it would cost to set it down. Not a refutation of the politics or the creed — a look at what the word does to the person wearing it.
series.shape: About three minutes. Black screen, white text, nothing else.
series.status: Four scripts finished. None cut yet.
series.coming: The list of labels runs longer than the ones already written, and the uncomfortable ones remain.

videos.title: You Are Not a Republican
videos.blurb: The promises set beside the results: jobs, borders, money, family. What a person owes a word that stopped matching the thing.

videos.title: You Are Not a Democrat
videos.blurb: The same operation, run the other direction, on the same machinery.

videos.title: You Are Not a Christian
videos.blurb: Two thousand years of schism, and the question of what survives when the label comes off.

videos.title: You Are Not Joe Sixpack
videos.blurb: Somebody invented the ordinary man to sell things to. The costume fits so well it stopped reading as a costume.

series.title: Conspiracy Crafter
series.blurb: Hidden history, and the words that carry it. These build a frame a viewer does not hold yet, then leave them holding it — and leave the seams visible, because a frame you can see works better than one you cannot.
series.shape: Two forms: a five-minute contemplative cut, and a three-minute one that never slows down.
series.status: Nothing published. Two scripts in the works, both at reference-draft stage — the templates got built against them, so they go last rather than first.
series.coming: One concerns what a language can do to the people inside it. The other concerns a word that stops a thing from existing by refusing to say it.

series.title: One-Offs
series.blurb: Standalone work that fits none of the backbones above. Same per-line discipline, bespoke spine, one episode at a time.
series.status: Nothing listed here yet. One script finished and a second in progress, both held back pending a decision about what belongs on a public shelf.
